basics.name: Amirreza Bagheridelouee
basics.label: Researcher at The Wharton School
basics.summary: Researcher at The Wharton School with a background in computer engineering and economics, and interests in industrial organization and empirical market design. My research experience combines large-scale data analysis, econometrics, machine learning, and computational modeling to study markets and the effects of technology.

work.name: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
work.summary: Research in economics, industrial organization, and market design.

researchProjects.name: FIFA Ticketing
researchProjects.researchFocus: Demand and trading activity in FIFA NFT and ticketing markets.
highlights: Scraped and analyzed 1M+ observations from FIFA Collectibles, World Cup 2026 tickets, and Fifachain transactions.
Combined marketplace and blockchain data to study demand and trading in FIFA NFT and ticketing markets.

researchProjects.name: Congestion Pricing and Carpooling
researchProjects.researchFocus: How congestion charges affect travel and carpooling decisions.
highlights: Built 1M+ Manhattan trip observations from Replica and Google Maps API to study congestion-pricing responses.
Built a Manhattan car-count dataset from 25,000+ hours of unstructured video footage.
Reviewed research on how congestion pricing and parking fees affect carpooling.

researchProjects.name: Power Plants, Transmission Lines, and Data Centers
researchProjects.researchFocus: Electricity generation under market bids and transmission-network constraints.
highlights: Developed a PowerModels.jl model to predict electricity generation from bid data and transmission-network constraints.
Compared ERCOT-SCED bids with realized generation and diagnosed inconsistencies in the energy-market data.

researchProjects.name: Port Substitution and Congestion in the Container Shipping Industry
researchProjects.researchFocus: Port substitution and congestion in container shipping.
highlights: Resolved vessel identities across 150M+ maritime AIS and Panjiva observations using a ship-matching algorithm.
Built reproducible customs and product-data pipelines and estimated trucking costs from fuel prices and wages.

researchProjects.name: Generative AI and Creative Goods
researchProjects.researchFocus: The effects of generative AI on markets for creative goods.
highlights: Created image-title and tag embeddings and used them to predict image sales with a tuned random-forest model.
Estimated generative-AI treatment effects using propensity-score matching and difference-in-differences.
